newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices rise ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices rise ahead of holiday.

text.p: Flour mills expecting a drop in millfeed production during the Memorial Day holiday week raised millfeed offering prices this week, dealers said.
Feedmixers also anticipating a drop in production inquired about purchases but as of midday Monday were resisting the higher offers.
"They (flour mills) are thinking this is the last shot at getting good prices before the summer," said a Buffalo dealer.
Historically, millfeed prices drop in June and stay low through the summer as livestock feed consumption declines and millfeed supplies increase.
A Texas dealer said feed mixers needed millfeeds through the next two weeks, but supplies were tight.
"There are feedmixers looking for quick feed. But this week is pretty cleaned up," he said.
